description: Clear scene state in one RPC. With `prefix` (e.g. 'e2e_') removes only objects / materials / non-active render data / non-main takes whose name starts with the prefix, then flushes the undo buffer — cheap cleanup for test suites. Without prefix, swaps the active document for a fresh empty BaseDocument (everything goes). Much faster than chained remove_entity calls when cleanup involves animated objects.

keep_active_rd.description: Prefix-mode only: protect the currently-active RenderData from deletion. Default true.

prefix.description: Only remove entities whose name starts with this prefix. Omit for full reset.

name: reset_scene
title: Reset Active Scene
